description: This file defines macros and a class related to CUDA error handling and assertions in the PyTorch c10 CUDA namespace. It includes external CUDA and c10 utility headers, and declares functions for CUDA error checking.

classes.name: c10::CUDAError
classes.description: A class representing CUDA-related errors, derived from c10::Error, with API export macro C10_CUDA_API.

methods.name: c10_cuda_check_implementation
methods.description: Function to handle CUDA error checking and device-side assertion failures, taking error code, filename, function name, line number, and a flag for device assertions.
